text:
ConocoPhillips dropped 4.7% today as crude oil prices fell more than 7% on hopes that the U.S. and Iran might resolve tensions through diplomacy rather than military conflict. Lower oil prices directly reduce the value of oil company earnings and reserves, which is why the stock moved sharply lower even though the company itself announced nothing today.

The broader backdrop matters here: oil majors like ConocoPhillips have benefited from geopolitical risk premiums and elevated prices over recent months, but any credible signal of de-escalation in the Middle East removes that premium. Even though Trump administration officials have made conflicting statements about Iran policy, the mere possibility of peace talks was enough to spook oil investors on Monday.
